notes.title: Bugfix & Polishing (Build 59)
notes.content: [h3]Greetings Champions![/h3][p][/p][p]We’ve just released a new update with some bug fixes and extra polish.[/p][p]Thanks a ton for all the feedback! It really helps us track down issues and improve the game.[/p][p][/p][h3]The demo is back![/h3][p]Now with updated features and adjusted content, perfect to share with friends who are still not sure![/p][p][/p][h3]Patch Notes[/h3][p]New[/p][list][*][p]Added a small intro animation and adjusted tutorial pages for first-time players.[/p][/*][*][p]Brought back the updated demo version to share with friends.[/p][/*][*][p]Added tooltips for Sanctum and Unveilings in the main menu to show how to unlock them.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a red preview highlight when dragging a card onto a Site if it can’t be played.[/p][/*][/list][p]Bugfix[/p][list][*][p]Fixed 'Brynhildr' always summoning from the leftmost slot when no Norse card was present.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed 'Golden Apple' showing the wrong trigger effect type in the tooltip.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed tutorial page not appearing after the boss intro as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed boss intros for 'Hel' and 'Medusa' being slightly misaligned.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed 'Fafnir' displaying the wrong quotes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed 'Divine Herald' temporarily becoming invisible when trying to summon another card.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Mana counter sometimes getting stuck.[/p][/*][/list][p]Update[/p][list][*][p]Unveilings now unlock after finishing 1 run (instead of reaching level 1).[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased font size for card tooltips.[/p][/*][*][p]Rearranged stat info in the card tooltip for better readability.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved clarity in the description for 'Tamamo no Mae'.[/p][/*][*][p]Made it clearer that your game is saved at the last cleared Aeon (checkpoint).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We’re really thankful for your support and hope you’ve been enjoying Pantheion so far! [/p][p][/p][p]If you’ve got suggestions or run into bugs, hop into our Discord or drop a post on the Steam forum.[/p][p][/p][p]Pantheion Team[/p]

notes.title: Pantheion is now live!
notes.content: [h3]Champions, the time has come![/h3][p]We’re excited to announce that [b]Pantheion is officially released[/b] as of [b]August 15th, 2025[/b]![/p][p][/p][h3]About the game[/h3][p]Build a deck with cards from different mythologies, from the mighty Zeus to Odin. Face a series of challenging encounters and stop the [b]Primordial Forces[/b] from destroying the world![/p][p]You’ll need to think carefully to overcome the [b]Sites’ curse effects[/b]. A colossal Deity might crush the competition, but a swarm of clever Followers might win through synergy and decide the victory.[/p][p][/p][h3]And thank you for playing our demo![/h3][p]We hope you’ve enjoyed it so far and your feedback has been invaluable. But the demo will be available later again for anyone who wants to share it with friends and it will receive updates from the full game. However, certain features will remain exclusive to the full release.[/p][p][/p][h3]What’s new?[/h3][list][*][p]A new Era where you can choose a [b]Divine Gift[/b] with unique effects to aid your journey.[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]unlockable cards[/b] for deckbuilding and strategic depth.[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]Primordial Forces[/b] with progressive difficulty for a greater challenge.[/p][/*][*][p]And much more, including content and improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p]Keep the feedback, ideas and bug reports coming by joining our Discord server![/p][p]The trials begin, will you rise as the world’s savior or fall into the shadow?[/p][p][b]May fate be with you![/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]The Pantheion Team[/i][/p]
